description: Collect any public X profile and its posts without login or cookies.

dateFrom.description: Optional. Only keep posts published on or after this date.
dateFrom.title: Posted after

dateTo.description: Optional. Only keep posts published on or before this date.
dateTo.title: Posted before

include.description: Pick one or more data groups. Everything works without cookies; X's login-only About panel is reported as unavailable.
include.title: What to collect

includeReplies.description: Also collect replies the account sent. Uses the guest UserTweetsAndReplies burst plus profile-scoped `filter:replies` search windows (may be empty when X refuses logged-out callers).
includeReplies.title: Include replies

includeRetweets.description: Keep retweets in the results. Turn off to get only posts the account wrote itself.
includeRetweets.title: Include retweets

language.description: Optional. Keep only posts detected in this language, e.g. `en`, `es`, `ja`. Leave empty for all languages.
language.title: Post language

maxPostsPerProfile.description: Target number of posts per account (1-1000). The actor merges the profile timeline, top posts, the replies timeline and profile-scoped search windows, then de-duplicates by post id before applying this cap. High values are filled with older posts when X search serves logged-out callers.
maxPostsPerProfile.title: Maximum posts per profile

minimumLikes.description: Optional. Drop posts with fewer likes than this.
minimumLikes.title: Minimum likes

minimumReplies.description: Optional. Drop posts with fewer replies than this.
minimumReplies.title: Minimum replies

minimumRetweets.description: Optional. Drop posts with fewer retweets than this.
minimumRetweets.title: Minimum retweets

onlyVerified.description: Skip accounts that do not carry a verified badge.
onlyVerified.title: Only verified accounts

onlyWithMedia.description: Keep only posts that contain photos, videos or GIFs.
onlyWithMedia.title: Only posts with images or videos

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if you plan large runs or see frequent rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional extras. The actor works fully without these.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

usernames.description: Accounts to collect. Paste handles like `elonmusk`, `@apify`, or full links like `https://x.com/elonmusk`. Handles and links can be mixed.
usernames.title: Twitter usernames or profile links

title: Twitter (X) Profile Scraper
